# Contributing to AR Corp Solutions

Thank you for your interest in contributing to AR Corp Solutions projects 🚀

We aim to maintain high-quality, consistent, and scalable code across all repositories in this organization. Please follow the guidelines below.

---

## 🧭 Getting Started

1. Clone the repository
2. Create a new feature branch from `develop`
3. Make your changes
4. Ensure all checks pass
5. Open a Pull Request (PR)

---

## 🌱 Branch Naming Convention

Use descriptive and consistent naming, better if suggested by the issue:

* `feature/<short-description>`
* `fix/<short-description>`
* `refactor/<short-description>`

Example:

```
feature/add-user-authentication
```

---

## 💬 Commit Messages

We follow a simplified Conventional Commits format:

```
[type]: short description
```

Types:

* `ADD` – add new feature or functionality
* `UPDATE` – update existing functionality
* `REMOVE` – remove functionality
* `FIX` – fix a bug
* `REFACTOR` – refactor code without changing behavior

Example:

```
[ADD]: JWT authentication middleware
```

---

## 🧪 Code Quality

Before submitting a PR:

* ✅ Code builds successfully
* ✅ Tests pass
* ✅ Linting passes
* ✅ No sensitive data is committed

---

## 🔍 Pull Request Guidelines

Each PR should:

* Clearly describe what was changed and why
* Reference related issues (if any)
* Be small and focused
* Include tests when applicable

Checklist:

* [ ] Code follows project standards
* [ ] Tests added/updated
* [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)

---

## 🤝 Code Review Process

* At least one approval is required
* Address all review comments before merging
* Be respectful and constructive

---

## 🧠 General Principles

* Prefer clarity over cleverness
* Write maintainable, readable code
* Avoid unnecessary complexity
* Think in terms of scalability and reuse

---

## ❓ Questions

If you're unsure about anything:

* Open a discussion
* Ask in the appropriate channel

We’re here to help.

---

Thanks for contributing 💙
AR Corp Solutions Engineering Team
